question: Do high long gdp per capita countries have higher negative affects? Explain the results.
query: ```sql WITH gdp_threshold AS (     SELECT          country_name,         percentile(log_GDP_per_capital, 75) as gdp_75th_percentile     FROM          world_happiness_report     GROUP BY          country_name ) SELECT      report.log_GDP_per_capital,     report.negative_affect FROM      world_happiness_report report WHERE      report.log_GDP_per_capital > (SELECT gdp_75th_percentile FROM gdp_threshold WHERE country_name = report.country_name) ORDER BY      negative_affect DESC LIMIT 50; ```
